title: Single Nucleus RNAseq Sample Prep from Nodose Ganglia
author: Sebastian Preissl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v72e9qe

steps.title: Prepare and Grind Tissue
steps.instruction: Process the nodose ganglia samples to create a pulverized tissue powder.

substeps.instruction: Dissect and flash freeze nodose ganglia in liquid nitrogen.
Store at -80C until ready for nuclei isolation.
Grind the sample with liquid nitrogen using a 1.5mL centrifuge tube and fitting pestle.

steps.title: Lyse Tissue
steps.instruction: Perform lysis of the pulverized tissue to release nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 ul Lysis Buffer to the pulverized tissue.
Pipette 10x up and down.
Place on ice.
Incubate for 5 min using an overhead shaker in the cold room.

steps.title: Clear Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample to remove the lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Spin down for 5 min at 500g and 4C using soft settings.
Remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and Filter Nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend the tissue and filter the suspension to remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend tissue in 400 ul Sorting Buffer by pipetting 10x up and down.
Filter through a green 30 um CellTRic (Sysmex) into a FACS tube.
Wash the filter with an additional 200 ul Sorting Buffer (SB).
Gently clap the rack against the bench to ensure full transfer of the nuclei suspension.

steps.title: Stain Nuclei
steps.instruction: Stain the nuclei for FACS identification.

substeps.instruction: Add 6 ul DRAQ7 (Cell signaling) to the sample.
Place the sample on ice.

steps.title: Prepare for FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Set up the collection tube and sorting parameters.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 ul Collection Buffer to a 1.5 ml LoBind tube.
Use a 100 um Chip for sorting.
Set the temperature for both sample and collection to 5C.
Identify single nuclei based on FSC/SSC signals and DRAQ7 fluorescence in the FL-6 (PE-Cy7) channel.

steps.title: Sort Nuclei
steps.instruction: Execute the sorting process to collect a specific number of nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Sort 60,000 (200 ul) nuclei (Gate: “Sorting”) using the “Purity” setting into the prepared collection tube.
After sorting (10-20 min), mix the sample and keep on ice.

steps.title: Recover Nuclei
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sorted nuclei and resuspend in recovery buffer.

substeps.instruction: Spin down for 15 min at 1000xg and 4C using a swinging bucket rotor.
Remove the supernatant, leaving the tiny blue pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 18 ul RB by pipetting 10x (expected recovery: 50-60%).
Leave the sample on ice.

steps.title: Quantify and Adjust Concentration
steps.instruction: Verify the single cell suspension and adjust the nuclei concentration.

substeps.instruction: Check for single cell suspension and count nuclei using a hemocytometer.
Mix 5 ul of sample with 5 ul of Trypan blue and count 4 big squares.
Calculate concentration: (counted number)/4*20 = nuclei/ul.
Adjust the concentration to 1000 nuclei/ul.

steps.title: Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Proceed with the 10xGenomics library prep protocol.
